notes.text: Security update for xorg-x11-server
notes.title: Title of the patch

notes.text:
This update for xorg-x11-server fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-88812: XKB SetGeometry TextDoodad double rree (bsc#1281213).
- CVE-2026-93515: X.Org Server present extension use-after-free (bsc#1281218).
- CVE-2026-93516: X.Org Server XInput passive grab use-after-free (bsc#1281220).
- CVE-2026-93517: GLX RenderLarge heap buffer overflow (bsc#1281225).
- CVE-2026-93518: XKB ResizeKeyType numeric truncation (bsc#1281227).
- CVE-2026-93519: XFixes pointer barrier event list buffer overflow (bsc#1281233).
- CVE-2026-93520: XKB ChangeKeycodeRange heap out-of-bounds write (bsc#1281236).
- CVE-2026-93521: RandR ChangeProviderProperty heap buffer overflow (bsc#1281238).
- CVE-2026-93523: XInput2 PassiveUngrabDevice out-of-bounds write (bsc#1281241).
- CVE-2026-93524: XKB SetMap key width/action count desync out-of-bounds read (bsc#1281242).
- CVE-2026-93536: GestureBuildSprite use-after-free (bsc#1281244).
- CVE-2026-109092: X.Org Server XvShmPutImage shared-memory bounds overflow (bsc#1285087).
- CVE-2026-109093: X.Org Server XTestFakeInput valuator stack out-of-bounds write (bsc#1285088).
- CVE-2026-109094: X.Org Server XRes QueryResourceBytes swap path size overflow (bsc#1285089).
- CVE-2026-109095: X.Org Server Glamor Xv image size integer overflow (bsc#1285090).
- CVE-2026-109096: X.Org Server XvPutImage negative image size length bypass (bsc#1285091).
- CVE-2026-109903: X.Org Server XvQueryImageAttributes negative size reply (bsc#1285093).
- CVE-2026-109904: X.Org Server XRes QueryClientIds request size overflow (bsc#1285094).
